name: Payment Plugins for Stripe Elementor – by Pay Addons
author: Payment Addons

sections.description:
Our drag-and-drop payment builder handles everything from simple payment buttons to complex recurring donation forms and event registration systems. No coding skills needed – build professional payment forms in minutes, not hours.

👉 Get Started in 3 Simple Steps

  1. Setup your Stripe API key
  2. Drag payment widgets from Pay Addons category to any Elementor page
  3. Go live and start collecting payments

customize payment form demo
customize payment form docs

✅ Drag & Drop Elementor Payment Form With your styles

No Elementor Pro license? Don’t worry, we provide a free form builder which is similar with Elementor Pro’s form. With the form builder, We can build any payment form with 10+ essential form fields plus specialized payment elements:

  • Form Fields: Text, email, textarea, URL, number, radio, select, checkbox, password, HTML, credit card, payment element
  • Custom Styling: Full control over form appearance – fields, buttons, labels, and layout
  • Stripe Checkout Redirect: Seamless redirect to secure, SCA-ready Stripe checkout pages with tax calculation

🔒 Form Submission to Secure Stripe Checkout Page

After clicking the form submission, your customers get redirected to Stripe’s secure, hosted checkout page that handles all payment complexities. Supports multiple payment methods, promotions, auto-tax, phone/address collection, and metadata – all configurable from your Elementor dashboard.

Complete Stripe Control: Access nearly all Stripe checkout settings including customer fields, dynamic pricing, quantities, and product configurations.

🔥 Pro Features – Accept Payments On-Site

Keep customers on your website with advanced payment processing:

  • 💳 Credit Card Form Field: Embed a credit card processing field directly in your forms
  • 🎯 Payment Element Form Field: Use Stripe’s Payment Element as a form field to accept 40+ payment methods
  • ✨ Elementor Pro Integration: Full compatibility with Elementor Pro forms including reCAPTCHA, multi-steps, and email actions, etc.
  • 🔄 Advanced Subscriptions: Flexible billing – daily, weekly, monthly, yearly with setup fees and occurrence limits

Powerful Features That Convert

🛠️ Elementor Widgets: Payment Form, Checkout buttons, confirmation summaries, pricing tables View Docs

💳 Global Payment Methods: Visa, MasterCard, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Alipay, WeChat, Afterpay, Klarna, PayPal*, and 40+ more

🎁 Ready-to-Use Templates: Pre-built payment page templates for instant deployment

✅ Custom Confirmation Pages: Professional receipts with merge fields using [epa-receipt] shortcode

🌎 Multi-Currency: Accept payments in any currency worldwide

📧 Smart Notifications: Automated customer emails with payment details

🎁 PayPal Integration: Available for European Stripe accounts (Learn More)

🏆 Stripe Verified Partner

PAY ADDONS is an official Stripe Verified Partner with early access to new features. This means better integration, faster updates, and the most reliable Stripe experience for Elementor users. All payment data syncs directly to your Stripe dashboard and we never touch on it.

Full Feature List

  • Powerful drag & drop payment form builder powered by Stripe
  • 100% mobile responsive design
  • Elementor Pro’s Form compatibility
  • Transaction list to record any form submission data
  • Transaction report overview
  • Enterprise-grade security by Stripe: PCI DSS compliant, SCA-ready, GDPR compliant. We never handle your payment data – customers transact directly with Stripe for maximum security.
  • Checkout Button (FREE): Redirect your customer to a stripe-hosting checkout page. (demo)
  • Confirmation Summary (FREE): Create your Thank You page after a successful purchase redirect with payment details.
  • Price Table (FREE): Create your price table with checkout action including recurring/subscription. (demo)
  • Customize confirmation page (Pro): Redirect to your own confirmation page with receipt featuring dozens of merge fields after payment.
  • Checkout Redirect Form (Pro): The most secure form checkout which will redirect to the secure stripe-hosting checkout page, support multi payment methods, one-time, recurring pay, coupon, tax, etc. (demo)
  • Checkout Credit Card Form (Pro): Create a flexable elementor form that includes a credit card field with one-time & recurring support. (demo)
  • Checkout Payment Element Form 🎉 (Pro): Create a flexable elementor form that includes multiple payment methods with one-time & recurring support, including Credit Cards, Google Pay, ApplePay, WeChat Pay, Alipay, Afterpay, ACH, Klarna, iDEAL, FPX, Grabpay, OXXO, Multibanco, Bancontact, EPS, P24, Giropay, Affirm, and more. (demo)
  • Decimal Form Field: Ideal for payment price inputs, allowing precise decimal values
  • Dynamic Php Code: Perfect for complex price calculations that require custom logic
  • Developer API: Extend functionality with our comprehensive developer interfaces

ABOUT US

We provide professional Stripe payment solutions for WordPress, with the following core products:

  • Elementor Stripe Payment
    Seamlessly integrate customized Stripe-powered payment forms into your Elementor site. Sell products, services, accept donations, and more through intuitive checkout experiences. Elementor Stripe Payment

  • Contact form 7 Stripe Payment
    Seamlessly integrate customized Stripe-powered payment forms into your Contact Form 7. Sell products, services, accept donations, and more through intuitive checkout experiences. Contact Form 7 Stripe Payment

  • WooCommerce Stripe Payment
    WooCommerce Stripe addon is a payment gateway for WooCommerce. With just a single configuration, unlock access to over 30 secure and globally recognized payment methods, including Credit Cards, Google Pay, ApplePay, WeChat Pay, Alipay, Afterpay, ACH, Klarna, iDEAL, FPX, Grabpay, OXXO, Multibanco, Bancontact, EPS, P24, Giropay, Affirm, and more. WooCommerce Stripe Payment

  • Stripe Express Payment
    Embed standalone variety of built-in stripe payment widgets, forms anywhere on your site using easy shortcodes, No store required to collect instant payments. Stripe Express

External services

This plugin connects to external services to provide payment processing and template functionality.

Stripe Payment Processing
The plugin connects to Stripe’s API (https://api.stripe.com/v1/) to process payments and manage transactions. – JavaScript library: https://js.stripe.com/v3/. Service provider: Stripe, Inc.

PayAddons Template Service
The plugin connects to PayAddons API (https://api.payaddons.com/elementor) to obtain Elementor widget templates for enhanced payment form designs. Service provider: PayAddons

No personal data is transmitted to these services without user consent during payment processing or template requests.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro to build forms?

No, it’s not required. Our plugin includes a powerful free form builder that supports custom styling and payments. For users who already have Elementor Pro, we also integrate seamlessly with its advanced form features for more complex forms.

Is Elementor Pro required to use your plugin?

No, Elementor Pro is not required to use our plugin. However, some premium features, such as payment forms based on Elementor forms, do require Elementor Pro.

Does this plugin only support stripe gateway? What about PayPal?

Yes, but Only for the Stripe Account In Europe.

Does this support recurring payments, like for subscriptions?

Yes, you can feel free to provide any subscription.

Does this support to integrate with Elementor Form?

Yes, but limitted to premium version only.

Does this require an SSL certificate?

Yes! In Live Mode, an SSL certificate must be installed on your site to use Stripe.

Does this support both production mode and sandbox mode for testing?

Yes, it does – You can switch them in plugin setting page.
